searchDocs.title: saveinstance​
searchDocs.content: </> SaveInstance.saveinstance( target: table | Instance | {Instance },-- the options table, or what to save as a model options: table?-- options, when the first argument is an instance or a list of instances ) → table-- { ok, path, bytes, instances, scripts, decompiler, elapsed, warnings } or { ok = false, error, trace } local saveinstance = loadstring(game:HttpGet( "https://sirmemegithub.com/RealSlimShady2000/SaveInstance420Edition/raw/branch/main/saveinstance.luau" ))() saveinstance() -- the whole place saveinstance({ Decompile = false }) -- map only saveinstance(workspace.SomeModel) -- one model

searchDocs.title: 1. Load and run​
searchDocs.content: Copy this into your executor, change any value, and run it while in a game. Left as is, it saves the whole place with decompiled scripts; every line shows the default and what the other choice does.  -- SaveInstance 420 Edition: change the values below, then run this in your executor while in a game. -- Every option: https://pages.sirmemegithub.com/SaveInstance420Edition/docs/options/ -- getgenv().RSOPS_OFF = true -- remove the "--" at the start to turn off run statistics for robloxscripts.com local saveinstance = loadstring(game:HttpGet( "https://sirmemegithub.com/RealSlimShady2000/SaveInstance420Edition/raw/branch/main/saveinstance.luau" ))() saveinstance({ -- What to save Mode = "optimized", -- "full": every service | "scripts": only what holds scripts NilInstances = false, -- true: also save instances parented to nil RemovePlayerCharacters = true, -- false: keep player characters in Workspace IsolateLocalPlayer = false, -- true: also save your PlayerGui, Backpack, ... -- Scripts Decompile = true, -- false: skip decompiling (much faster, map only) -- StreamingEnabled games SetStreaming = false, -- true: load the rest of the map before saving StreamingAreaSize = 10000, -- size of the area to load around you, in studs -- Output FilePath = false, -- "My save": fixed file name (no extension) ShowStatus = true, -- false: hide the progress panel NeutralizeLighting = false, -- true: reset dark or foggy lighting before saving SafeMode = false, -- true: disconnect from the server before writing the file Debug = false, -- true: write a log to SaveInstance420/ in your workspace })   SaveInstance tracks execution data (run statistics) for robloxscripts.com: versions, executor, game ids and counts of the features used, never your account name or id. To turn it off, run getgenv().RSOPS_OFF = true before the loader. See Run statistics and privacy.  The panel at the bottom of the screen shows each stage: decompiling scripts, then saving instances. Stay in the game until it says Saved. A big game (hundreds of thousands of instances, thousands of scripts) takes a few minutes, mostly decompiling.  The console prints a summary when it finishes:  [SaveInstance] scripts: 5005 decompiled, 907 reused, 5 failed, 74 server-only, 14 without source [SaveInstance] saved Blox Fruits - 2753915549 - 2026-11-23 19.32.47.rbxlx: 167018 instances, 177.7 MB in 4m 46s

searchDocs.title: 2. Find the file​
searchDocs.content: Look in your executor's workspace folder. The name is the place name, place id and UTC time:  Blox Fruits - 2753915549 - 2026-11-23 19.32.47.rbxlx   Set FilePath = "My save" for a fixed name instead (no extension; an existing file with that name is replaced).  Open the file in Roblox Studio. Check a building near you, something far away, the terrain and a few scripts. A finished save means the file was written; it does not prove the client had the whole map (see streaming).  ServerStorage.SaveInstance420 holds a README and anything saved by the extras options.

searchDocs.title: 3. Adjust the next save​
searchDocs.content: You want	UseThe rest of a streaming map	SetStreaming = true, see Load streamed regions Only the map, fast	Decompile = false One model	saveinstance(workspace.TheModel) Your player's GUI and tools	IsolateLocalPlayer = true Things parented to nil	NilInstances = true A log to share	Debug = true, then send SaveInstance420/debug <time>.log  Every setting is in the options reference.

searchDocs.title: Save a model​
searchDocs.content: Pass the instance itself, not its name:  saveinstance(workspace:WaitForChild("YourModel"))   This writes YourModel - <place id> - <time>.rbxmx. If the instance does not exist (for example FindFirstChild returned nil), saveinstance raises an error instead of saving the whole place. Several at once:  saveinstance({ workspace.BuildingA, workspace.BuildingB }, { FilePath = "Two buildings" })

searchDocs.title: Use the result in a script​
searchDocs.content: local result = saveinstance({ Decompile = false, ShowStatus = false }) if result.ok then print("saved", result.path, result.instances, "instances") else warn("save failed:", result.error) end

searchDocs.title: What is sent​
searchDocs.content: When	WhatWhen SaveInstance loads	SaveInstance's version, the reporter's version, Roblox's version, your executor and its version, the game's place id, universe id and place version, the server kind, device type, OS, Roblox's language, whether your executor reads Roblox's error codes, and start-up time. Every 5 minutes while the game runs	Re-runs, whether SaveInstance loaded, and counts of what you used: the save type (place, model, scripts mode), the decompiler kind (for example Oracle or native), the options switched on (streaming, nil instances, ...), whether each save worked, and how many errors happened. When the session ends	Why it ended (left, kicked, disconnected, ...) and Roblox's error code.

searchDocs.title: What is never sent​
searchDocs.content: Your Roblox user id, name or display name. The reporter reads them only to remove them from any text before sending.The server's JobId, private server ids, or hardware ids.Anything from the place you save: no instances, scripts, names or file paths.  Error and kick text is scrubbed of names and file paths on your device and again on robloxscripts.com, and is kept only when the project collects text. For SaveInstance that setting is off, so only counts are kept.  The reporter runs on its own thread and cannot stop a save: if robloxscripts.com is down or blocked, SaveInstance works the same.

searchDocs.title: Turn it off​
searchDocs.content: Any of these stops it:  getgenv().RSOPS_OFF = true -- before loading SaveInstance   Create the file rsops/optout.txt in your executor's workspace folder (turns it off for every script that uses Script Ops).RSOps.off() stops it for the rest of the current game session.  The reporter checks these before every message it sends.

searchDocs.title: The code​
searchDocs.content: The tracking line is the first thing in saveinstance.luau, right under a comment that explains it (source: src/prelude/telemetry.luau). The reporter it loads, https://robloxscripts.com/ops/v1.lua, is one plain readable file: no obfuscation, no hooks, no files written.

searchDocs.title: Which decompiler runs​
searchDocs.content: Whatever decompile() is installed when the save starts is what runs:  A loader's hook, such as Oracle from your autoexec folder. Loaders replace getgenv().decompile with a function that sends the bytecode to their service.Your executor's native decompile(), when no loader replaced it.The lua.expert API, when there is no decompile() at all and the executor has request and getscriptbytecode. Turn this off with DecompilerFallback = false.Otherwise scripts are saved with a note saying no decompiler was available.  SaveInstance works out which one it is and writes that name into the console, the status panel and the first line of every saved source:  -- SaveInstance 420 Edition: decompiled with Oracle   Label	How it is recognisedOracle, lua.expert, Konstant, Medal	A hook whose code contains that service's address. Volt decompile() (your executor's name)	The executor's own native function. decompile() hook	Any other hook. Name it with the registration below.  To name a provider yourself, register it after its loader runs (the 1.x convention still works), or pass DecompilerName for one save:  getgenv().__SaveInstanceDecompiler = { Name = "My provider", Function = getgenv().decompile }

searchDocs.title: Oracle​
searchDocs.content: Oracle is a paid decompiler service. With its loader in your autoexec folder, every save decompiles through Oracle, and each unique script is one Oracle request against your plan. Scripts that share bytecode and scripts already decompiled this session are not requested again.  Oracle's loader returns its error messages as if they were source code. SaveInstance checks every answer:  Oracle says	What SaveInstance doesKey has expired, key not redeemed, quota used up	Stops sending requests immediately and saves the remaining scripts with a note. The console shows Oracle's message. Too many requests	Halves the number of requests in flight, waits (2 s, doubling up to 30 s), and retries the script. -- Decompilation failed! and other error stubs	Marks that script as failed and tries it once more at the end.  Error text is never saved as a script's source and never cached.

searchDocs.title: What can be decompiled​
searchDocs.content: Script	ResultLocalScript, ModuleScript	Decompiled. Script with RunContext = Client	Decompiled. Server Script	A note. Server code never reaches the client. Scripts under DecompileIgnore	A note; the instance is still saved. Engine default player scripts	Left out (IgnoreDefaultPlayerScripts), so Studio uses its own working copies.

searchDocs.title: Speed​
searchDocs.content: Decompiling happens before the file is written, in a pool:  Scripts with identical bytecode are decompiled once (big games reuse hundreds of copies).Up to DecompileConcurrency requests are in flight at once (default 16). HTTP decompilers such as Oracle spend most of their time waiting on the network, so this is about 8 times faster than one at a time: 43 scripts in 1.3 s, and Blox Fruits' 5,000 unique scripts in about 4.5 minutes. A native decompiler runs one script at a time between frames.Each script has DecompileTimeout seconds: 30 for HTTP hooks, 10 for native decompilers. Scripts that fail or time out get one more try on their own with three times as long.Results are cached for the rest of the session (ScriptCache), so saving again is fast and costs no new Oracle requests.  The lua.expert fallback runs one request at a time, DecompilerApiGap seconds apart (default 0.12), because the API rejects bursts.  A thread that overruns its deadline is abandoned, not cancelled: cancelling a thread inside a native decompiler crashes Volt.

searchDocs.title: When decompiling fails​
searchDocs.content: The source says why, for example decompile failed: timed out after 30s or decompiler returned nothing. Some scripts (Actor scripts, unusual bytecode) consistently return nothing from a given decompiler; that is the decompiler's limit, not the save's.  Decompiled code is a reconstruction. Names of locals are lost and some constructs need manual fixes.SaveBytecode = true appends the bytecode (base64) to each source so you can decompile it again later with another tool.Map only: Decompile = false skips the whole step.

searchDocs.title: How the sweep works​
searchDocs.content: A grid of points covers StreamingAreaSize around StreamingCenter (your character by default), StreamingRadius studs apart, at StreamingSlices heights.Up to StreamingConcurrency points are requested at once with Player:RequestStreamAroundAsync. A request that hangs past StreamingTimeout is abandoned (on empty or ocean regions it can hang longer than its own timeout).After each request, the region's anchored part count is watched until it stops changing, for up to StreamingChunkWait seconds.When the grid is done, or StreamingMaxTime runs out, the save waits StreamingSettleTime seconds for late arrivals.  While the sweep and the save run, Workspace.StreamOutBehavior is set to LowMemory so the client keeps what it loaded; it is restored afterwards. Terrain is read when the file is written, after the sweep.  The console reports the outcome:  [SaveInstance] streaming: 121/121 regions requested, 0 failed, 3 still loading, 2m 14s

searchDocs.title: Choosing the area​
searchDocs.content: Map	TrySmall arena	StreamingAreaSize = 1500 City or island	StreamingAreaSize = 4000 Huge open world	Save in parts: several runs with different StreamingCenter values, or StreamingPoints = { ... }  The grid is limited to 10,000 requests. A bigger StreamingRadius means fewer requests and less detail per request. Making the engine's own streaming radius huge does not help: it loads more at once and can run the client out of memory.

searchDocs.title: What streaming cannot do​
searchDocs.content: It cannot load what the server refuses to send.The game can still remove parts on its own (cleanup, round changes).A region that "settled" is an observation, not proof that every part arrived. Check distant landmarks in Studio.  StreamingPreview (the area visualizer from 1.x) has not been carried over to 2.0 yet.

searchDocs.title: What to save​
searchDocs.content: Option	Default	What it doesMode	"optimized"	"optimized" saves the services a place needs. "full" saves every saveable service. "scripts" keeps only branches that contain scripts ("script" is an alias). Object	false	An instance or list of instances to save as a model (.rbxmx). A service is saved as a folder. Object = game is the same as Mode = "full". IsModel	automatic	true when Object is set. Set false to save Object as a place. IgnoreList	{ "CoreGui", "CorePackages" }	Leave out instances and everything under them. Entries: an instance, a class name, or ClassName = { "Name", ... }. [instance] = false keeps the instance but drops its children. IgnoreProperties	{}	Property names never to write, e.g. { "Transparency" }. IgnoreNotArchivable	true	Also save instances with Archivable = false. Set false to skip them. RemovePlayerCharacters	true	Leave player characters out of Workspace. NilInstances	false	Save instances parented to nil (needs getnilinstances). IsolateLocalPlayer	false	Save your Player's contents (PlayerGui, Backpack, ...) as folders. IsolateLocalPlayerCharacter	false	Save your character. IsolatePlayers	false	Save every Player as folders. IsolateStarterPlayer	false	Also save a copy of StarterPlayer's contents as folders. ExtraInstances	{}	More instances to include. SaveNotCreatable	false	Save instances of classes Studio cannot create (Player, PlayerGui, ...) as folders instead of leaving them out.  Extras from NilInstances, the Isolate* options and ExtraInstances go into ServerStorage.SaveInstance420, where they neither run nor render in Studio.

searchDocs.title: Scripts​
searchDocs.content: Option	Default	What it doesDecompile	true	Decompile LocalScripts and ModuleScripts. false keeps the script instances with a note. Legacy: noscripts. DecompileTimeout	automatic	Seconds per script: 30 for HTTP hooks such as Oracle, 10 for native decompilers. Failed scripts get one more try with three times as long. 0 = no limit. Legacy: timeout. DecompileConcurrency	16	Requests in flight at once. Halves by itself when the provider says it is rate limited. DecompileIgnore	{ "TextChatService" }	Save these scripts (and scripts under these instances) without decompiling them. Same entry format as IgnoreList. IgnoreDefaultPlayerScripts	true	Leave out the engine's copies of PlayerModule, RbxCharacterSounds, ChatScript and BubbleChat, so Studio uses its working defaults. ScriptCache	true	Reuse decompiled sources for the rest of the session (same bytecode = same source). Legacy: scriptcache. DecompileJobless	false	Only use cached sources; decompile nothing new. SaveBytecode	false	Append each script's bytecode (base64) to its source. DecompilerFallback	true	When the executor has no decompile(), send bytecode to the lua.expert API instead. DecompilerApiUrl	lua.expert	Endpoint for the fallback. DecompilerApiGap	0.12	Seconds between fallback requests. DecompilerName	automatic	Label written into each source header. Detected automatically for Oracle, lua.expert, Konstant, Medal and native decompilers.

searchDocs.title: Properties​
searchDocs.content: Option	Default	What it doesIgnoreDefaultProperties	true	Skip properties equal to the class default. Makes files much smaller. IgnoreSpecialProperties	false	Never call gethiddenproperty. Use only if it crashes your executor: union data and some hidden properties will be missing. UseUGCValidationService	true	Use UGCValidationService as a last-resort hidden-property reader. TreatUnionsAsParts	false	Save unions as Parts. IgnoreSharedStrings	false	Leave out SharedString properties (union meshes, tags). Only for executors that crash on them.

searchDocs.title: Streaming​
searchDocs.content: See Load streamed regions.  Option	Default	What it doesSetStreaming	false	Request the map around you before saving. Alias: Streaming. StreamingAreaSize	10000	Side of the square to sweep, in studs. StreamingRadius	512	Grid spacing and settle radius, in studs. StreamingCenter	character	Vector3 center of the sweep. StreamingSlices	2	Vertical layers per grid point. StreamingPasses	1	Repeat the sweep (1 to 3). StreamingPoints	false	Your own list of Vector3 points instead of a grid. StreamingConcurrency	4	Requests in flight (max 8). StreamingTimeout	20	Seconds per request. StreamingChunkWait	6	Seconds to wait for a region's parts to stop changing. StreamingSettleTime	5	Pause after the sweep for late arrivals. StreamingMaxTime	automatic	Overall limit in seconds (max 3600).

searchDocs.title: Output and behavior​
searchDocs.content: Option	Default	What it doesFilePath	automatic	File name without extension. Default: <place name> - <place id> - <UTC time>. Legacy: FileName. Callback	false	A function that receives the file in chunks instead of writing it. ShowStatus	true	Show the progress panel. ReadMe	true	Add a README ModuleScript to ServerStorage.SaveInstance420. Debug	false	Write a log to SaveInstance420/debug <time>.log. NeutralizeLighting	false	Reset the live Lighting to clear midday before saving, so the file does not open dark or foggy. SafeMode	false	Disconnect from the server before writing the file and turn off 3D rendering while it runs. Streaming is skipped in SafeMode, since it needs the connection. AntiIdle	true	Stop the 20-minute idle kick during long saves. ShutdownWhenDone	false	Close the game when the save finishes. YieldBudget	8	Milliseconds of work per frame. Raise for speed, lower if the game stutters.

searchDocs.title: Result​
searchDocs.content: saveinstance() returns a table:  { ok = true, path = "Blox Fruits - 2753915549 - 2026-11-23 19.25.00.rbxlx", bytes = 186310284, instances = 167018, scripts = { decompiled = 5005, cached = 907, failed = 5, server = 74, unavailable = 14, total = 6005 }, decompiler = "Oracle", decompilerStopped = nil, -- or the provider's message when it stopped answering (expired key, quota) elapsed = 286.8, warnings = {}, }   On failure: { ok = false, error = "...", trace = "..." }. While a save runs, getgenv().SaveInstance420Status holds the current phase, done, total, bytes and elapsed.

searchDocs.title: Run statistics​
searchDocs.content: Run statistics for robloxscripts.com are not a saveinstance() option: they start when the script loads. Turn them off with getgenv().RSOPS_OFF = true before loading, or with rsops/optout.txt in your executor's workspace. See Run statistics and privacy.

searchDocs.title: Retired options​
searchDocs.content: DecompilePrepass, PrepassConcurrency, PrepassMaxTime, PrepassRateGap, PrepassApiUrl, PrepassMaxScripts, SaveCacheInterval, AlternativeWritefile, SharedStringOverwrite, NilInstancesFixes, NotCreatableFixes, Anonymous, StreamingPreview, StreamingRequireComplete, StreamingCancel, StreamingValidate and ExportObj are not part of 2.0. Retired names are ignored; the Prepass* ones are covered by the options under Scripts.

searchDocs.title: Layout​
searchDocs.content: File	Rolesrc/main.luau	Entry point: phases, status, result table. src/options.luau	Defaults, legacy aliases, call forms. src/env.luau	Executor function lookup, base64/hash/SharedString keys (EncodingService first). src/schema.luau	Saved properties per class: live ReflectionService merged with the snapshot, read strategies, defaults. src/schema_snapshot.luau	Generated from the Full API dump. Do not edit. src/quirks.luau	Exceptions the metadata gets wrong: blocked members, scriptable twins, rebuilt values, unsaveable classes. src/attributes.luau	AttributesSerialize binary format. src/encode.luau	XML encoders per value type. src/collect.luau	Roots, ignore rules, extras, script list. src/scripts.luau	Decompiler selection, worker pool, cache. src/serialize.luau	Writes the document. src/writer.luau	Chunked file output. src/streaming.luau	Streaming sweep. src/ui.luau	Status panel. src/telemetry.luau	Run statistics: load success, feature and error counts for robloxscripts.com. src/prelude/telemetry.luau	Not a module: the Script Ops line, pasted first in the bundle under its disclosure comment.  Modules use require("name"); tools/bundle.mjs wraps each one in a function and resolves those calls inside the single output file. Files in src/prelude/ are copied verbatim to the top of the bundle instead, before any module runs. The bundle passes the ops handle they define to main, and reports a failed load as ready(false, "load_error"). Delete the prelude to build without run statistics.

searchDocs.title: Build​
searchDocs.content: node tools/bundle.mjs   Bump version.json for releases; the bundle header and the status panel show it.  Run the collection regression checks locally with lune run tools/test-collect.luau. Run Content serialization checks with lune run tools/test-content.luau andpython tools/test_content.py.  If Xeno closes Roblox before the status panel appears, copy the rebuilt bundle tossi-dev/saveinstance.luau in its workspace and run examples/diagnose-xeno.luau. The last line in ssi-dev/startup.log distinguishes compilation, initialization, and the start of the save. A native crash cannot be caught by Lua's pcall. With Debug = true, SaveInstance420/last-operation.log is overwritten before nil-instance enumeration and hidden-property native calls, so it survives a process crash. This adds synchronous disk writes; turn debug off after diagnosis.

searchDocs.title: Update the property snapshot​
searchDocs.content: After a Roblox update:  node tools/gen-schema.mjs node tools/bundle.mjs   The generator reads Roblox-Client-Tracker's Full-API-Dump.json. Never switch it to API-Dump.json or Mini-API-Dump.json: those drop hidden members such as Color3uint8 and size, and every part loses its color and size.

searchDocs.title: Test against a live game​
searchDocs.content: With the ExecutorMCP bridge running and its connector injected in a game:  node tools/live.mjs check # build, deploy, compile in-game node tools/live.mjs save "{ Decompile = false }" # run a save and validate the file node tools/live.mjs save "{ Object = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') }" node tools/live.mjs eval "return #game:GetDescendants()"   SSI_WORKSPACE overrides the executor workspace folder (Volt's is detected automatically) and SSI_BRIDGE the bridge address. Development saves are kept out of the run statistics (the script sets RSOPS_OFF only while the bundle loads); set SSI_OPS=1 to include them.  python tools/validate.py <file> checks a saved file: unique referents, resolving Refs and SharedString keys, no duplicate properties, valid base64, plus a census of classes and value types.

searchDocs.title: Rules learned the hard way​
searchDocs.content: Never task.cancel a thread that may be inside a native decompiler: Volt crashes. Abandon it.Never wrap an executor's request in task.spawn: some executors' request breaks there.Every loop over a whole game must call Util.step(), or big games freeze.Never write UniqueId or HistoryId: duplicates corrupt places.

searchDocs.title: The save fails or stops​
searchDocs.content: Symptom	Try[SaveInstance] save failed: ... in the console	The message names the stage. Send it with the debug log. Studio reports Content property conflict	Re-export with the updated bundle, which writes the modern Content property first and only uses its legacy counterpart as a fallback. To repair an existing XML save, run python tools/repair-content.py "path/to/save.rbxlx"; it writes a separate - fixed copy and preserves the original. It sits on "Decompiling scripts"	A remote decompile() hook may be rate-limiting: lower DecompileConcurrency (for example 4). Or skip it: Decompile = false. The game stutters a lot while saving	Lower YieldBudget (for example 4). The executor crashes	Try IgnoreSpecialProperties = true (no gethiddenproperty calls), then IgnoreSharedStrings = true. Each removes some data from the save. "A save is already running"	Wait for the first one, or rejoin if it crashed mid-save.  A save that failed deletes its partial file.

searchDocs.title: Missing or wrong content​
searchDocs.content: What you see	Why, and what to doScripts save but the map is missing	Use Mode = "optimized" or "full". "scripts" (alias "script") excludes branches without scripts. NilInstances = false still saves the map in Workspace; nil extras are stored separately in ServerStorage. Distant areas missing	The game streams. Use SetStreaming = true, see streaming. Unions are plain boxes	Unions made with newer Studio keep their shape in SolidMeshHolder, which no executor can read. Nothing on the client can recover those. TreatUnionsAsParts = true turns them into Parts instead. MeshParts are grey boxes	The mesh asset is private to the game's owner, so Studio cannot download it. Textures or sounds missing	Same cause: asset permissions. The save keeps the asset ids. Server scripts only contain a note	Server code never reaches the client. A script says decompile failed	See Decompile scripts. The place opens dark or foggy	That is the game's real lighting. NeutralizeLighting = true resets it before saving. My character will not spawn in Studio	Move the scripts out of StarterPlayer, then run game:GetService("Players").CharacterAutoLoads = true in the command bar. The camera will not move	workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Fixed, or delete the Camera.

searchDocs.title: Check a file without Studio​
searchDocs.content: The repository has a validator that checks structure (unique referents, references, SharedStrings, base64) and prints what is in the file:  python tools/validate.py "path/to/save.rbxlx"

searchDocs.title: Report a problem​
searchDocs.content: Include the place, your executor, the options you used, what went wrong, and the debug log. Report issues on the self-hosted repository.
